tagline: Real rules. Real signs. Short 3D lessons.
disclaimer: Sygnal is a training aid. It does not replace a driving school or the official exam.
whoGoesFirst: Tap the vehicles in the order they may go.
onboardingTitle: Pick the rules of the road
onboardingBody: Language is how the app talks. Country is which signs and right-of-way you learn. They are separate on purpose.
examIntro: 32 questions, WORD-style scoring. 68 of 74 to pass. No countdown on the main path.
driveHint: Desktop: WASD or arrows to roll. Phone: hold Drive to follow the practice loop.
missingLesson: This lesson is not in the selected country pack.

scene.uncontrolled: Nobody has a priority sign. Who goes first?
scene.priority: The yellow diamond is a priority road.
scene.leftTurn: A left turn meets oncoming traffic.
scene.roundabout: Traffic already on the roundabout has priority.
scene.tram: A tram approaches from the left.
scene.pedestrian: A pedestrian is on the crossing you would enter.

reason.pedestrian: Pedestrians on the crossing go first.
reason.tram: Tram has priority at this uncontrolled junction.
reason.fourWayStop: All-way stop: first to arrive, then the right.
reason.yieldToRight: Yield to the vehicle on the right.

reasonDetail.pedestrian: A person already on the crossing you would enter goes before any turning or through car.
reasonDetail.emergency: Blue lights in use: make a gap. A priority-road plate does not beat them.
reasonDetail.alreadyInside: Whoever is already in the junction or circulating is finishing first.
reasonDetail.trafficLight: A working signal outranks signs and yield-to-the-right.
reasonDetail.tram: Here a tram outranks ordinary vehicles, even if a car is on the right.
reasonDetail.priorityRoad: Traffic on the priority road goes before yield or unsigned sides.
reasonDetail.stop: Full halt, then go only when the way is clear.
reasonDetail.yield: Wait for the intersecting road, even if it looks empty at first glance.
reasonDetail.fourWayStop: First to arrive goes first; if they arrived together, yield to the right.
reasonDetail.yieldToRight: If paths would cross, wait for the vehicle on your right. Size does not count.

teach.languageVsRules: Language is the interface. Country is the code.
teach.collectionEmpty: Finish a lesson to pin plates here.
teach.lockedPath: Locked until the previous unit is done
teach.engineNote: The 3D scene is a picture. The TypeScript rules engine is the answer key.
